title: Keep component styles together
summary: Styles inside a shadow root usually apply to its internal elements.

Explain the example for keep component styles together

blocks.text: Styles inside a shadow root usually apply to its internal elements. They do not select unrelated elements elsewhere on the page.
Run these HTML examples in this site's HTML playground. Each example defines its own custom element in a fresh page. No extra JavaScript library is needed.

items: `customElements.define` registers a hyphenated tag name with its class. Register a given name only once per document.
`attachShadow` creates the component's internal shadow root. Open mode allows access through its `shadowRoot` property.

blocks.text: Only Inside note gets this green rule. The outside paragraph keeps its own style.

blocks.text: This example uses a fixed, trusted string. Do not build innerHTML from untrusted user text.
